snippet.title: Oh Puck! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
★ WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM ★
► STORE PAGE https://store.steampowered.com/app/4146710/Oh_Puck/

Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!
